chemistry-e6-q2.goal: Apply principles to solve the inquiry problem.

chemistry-killer-06.title: Rentang owah warna indikator
chemistry-killer-06.goal: Apply principles to solve the inquiry problem.
chemistry-killer-06.material:
Rentang owah warna indikator yaiku kaya ing ngisor iki.
Metil oranye: pH < 3.1 abang, 3.1 ~ 4.4 oranye, pH > 4.4 kuning
BTB: pH < 6.0 kuning, 6.0 ~ 7.6 ijo, pH > 7.6 biru
Fenolftalein: pH < 8.3 ora awarna, 8.3 ~ 10.0 jambon, pH > 10.0 abang
Iki asil nitesake telung indikator ing saben telung larutan banyu saben dina.
(A) Larutan model asam lambung: metil oranye abang, BTB kuning, fenolftalein ora awarna
(B) Larutan sing bereaksi sawise ditambahake antasida kanthi cukup: metil oranye kuning, BTB kuning, fenolftalein ora awarna
(C) Larutan banyu natrium bikarbonat encer: metil oranye kuning, BTB biru, fenolftalein ora awarna
Nalika rentang pH sing nyukupi asil kabeh telung indikator ditemtokake kanthi paling sempit, pasangan endi sing bener kanggo rentang pH (A), (B), (C) kanthi urutan kasebut?

Fenolftalein: pH < 8.3 ora awarna, 8.3 ~ 10.0 jambon, pH > 10.0 abang
Iki asil nitesake telung indikator ing saben telung larutan banyu saben dina.
(A) Larutan model asam lambung: metil oranye abang, BTB kuning, fenolftalein ora awarna
(B) Larutan sing bereaksi sawise ditambahake antasida kanthi cukup: metil oranye kuning, BTB kuning, fenolftalein ora awarna
(C) Larutan banyu natrium bikarbonat encer: metil oranye kuning, BTB biru, fenolftalein ora awarna
Nalika rentang pH sing nyukupi asil kabeh telung indikator ditemtokake kanthi paling sempit, pasangan endi sing bener kanggo rentang pH (A), (B), (C) kanthi urutan kasebut?
chemistry-killer-06.s.s1.explain:
(A): metil oranye abang pH < 3.1, BTB kuning pH < 6.0, fenolftalein ora awarna pH < 8.3. Rentang umum pH < 3.1.
(B): metil oranye kuning pH > 4.4, BTB kuning pH < 6.0, fenolftalein ora awarna pH < 8.3. Rentang umum 4.4 < pH < 6.0.
(C): metil oranye kuning pH > 4.4, BTB biru pH > 7.6, fenolftalein ora awarna pH < 8.3. Rentang umum 7.6 < pH < 8.3.
Jawaban: (A) pH < 3.1, (B) 4.4 < pH < 6.0, (C) 7.6 < pH < 8.3 (b). (Jawaban salah: nganggep (A) minangka rentang oranye 3.1 ~ 4.4 yaiku nyampuradukake abang lan oranye, nganggep (B) minangka 6.0 ~ 7.6 yaiku nyampuradukake BTB kuning lan ijo, lan pilihan pungkasan mung nggunakake rentang saka siji indikator BTB, mula dudu rentang sing paling sempit)
